subject: Hosted API renewal — tier realignment and soft-burst terms
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Marino <sasha@trellisworks.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion: Hosted API monthly commitments & tier mapping

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for taking time last week. Attached is a short proposal that maps TrellisWorks' observed usage to a renewal structure that helps you avoid unpredictable overages while lowering unit cost. High-level summary: 

- Current monthly hosted commit: 350M tokens (moving average).
- Proposed renewal: 900M monthly commit (12-month term) + 200M soft-burst pool available for seasonal spikes.
- New rate bands: three-tier pricing with step-down unit price after 600M and 800M thresholds.
- Soft-throttle guardrails: hard rate-limit per second preserved; soft-burst gives short-lived capacity with agreed throttling fallback.

I've attached the pricing sheet (Trellis_MA_Pricing_2026.pdf) and a usage snapshot for Oct (usage_report_Oct2026.csv). Proposed next steps:

1) Quick alignment call Monday (15–30m) to confirm burst window needs and SLA exceptions.
2) We prepare a redline-ready amendment and DocuSign packet once we confirm numbers.

If you're comfortable with the headline numbers, I'll loop in Karthik on the operational configuration (burst windows, rate limits, billing cadence).

Best,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Laura —

Thanks for the proposal and the usage snapshot. A few quick items from our side before the call: 

- We like the idea of a soft-burst pool — CyberWeek last year drove a 4x spike for ~48 hours. How strict is the per-second hard limit when a burst is used? We need to avoid tail latency that impacts customer experience.
- Can you confirm the unit price at 900M vs 1.2B? The spreadsheet looks like there is a step-down but there are two different columns and I'm not sure which applies.
- Procurement will need a statement of work (SOW) stub and a SOC 2 attestation included with the renewal packet.

I can do Monday at 10:00 PT for a 20‑minute call. Procurement copied here (procurement@trellisworks.com) — they will push PO processing as soon as we have the DocuSign packet.

Thanks,

Sasha Marino
Head of Platform, TrellisWorks
sasha@trellisworks.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-30T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: Hosted API monthly commitments & tier mapping

Hi Sasha —

Appreciate the questions. A few clarifications inline and a suggested contracted approach: 

1) Hard rate limits vs soft-burst: the per-second hard limit is enforced to protect noisy neighbors and is unchanged. The soft-burst pool is a separate credit bucket that lets short sustained bursts consume additional tokens above the committed band before fallback to the next-compatible model variant (we can also configure priority routing for your traffic so tail latency is minimized).

2) Pricing clarity: the attached PDF has two columns — "Standard Ladder" and "Commit Ladder." For renewals with committed monthly minimums we apply the Commit Ladder pricing. At 900M/month the blended unit price after thresholds is $0.0009/token; at 1.2B/month it drops to $0.00078/token. We'll spell this out in the amendment.

3) Docs for procurement: we'll include SOC 2 Type II evidence links, the short SOW stub for operational responsibilities, and a standard SLA appendix. I'll attach the SOC 2 link in the DocuSign packet.

Commercial concession: if TrellisWorks signs a 12-month renewal at >=900M/month and agrees to the soft-burst pool (200M), Redwood will: 
- Apply a 10% credit on the first two months' invoices (applied as invoice credit);
- Reserve burst capacity during peak windows you identify (up to two 72-hour windows per quarter).

Next steps: Laura, please schedule the Monday call with Sasha at 10:00 PT and create an ops ticket for Karthik to run the burst window sizing exercise. Procurement: once we send DocuSign I'll flag the packet for expedited review.

-Markus

Markus Klein
